entities.summary: Daphne Touw is a former field hockey goalkeeper from the Netherlands, who played 68 international matches for the Dutch National Women's Team. She made her debut on 3 July 1993 against Germany, and was a member of the team that won the bronze medal at the 2000 Summer Olympics in Sydney, Australia.
